text:
Alice N.: Heads up — partners: we need to coordinate the v1->v2 API sunset ripple across marketplace, HW SIs, and joint press. Proposed timeline: announce 2026-05-01, deprecate 2026-08-01. Thoughts?

Samir K.: Timeline looks OK for most customers. Need to confirm Dedicated SLA impact — enterprise customers require a 60-day extended window. Also: HW partners will need an SDK/firmware bump, correct?

Jessie P.: For marketplace vendors: they need at least a 30-day patch window after announcement. Can we offer a temporary compatibility shim for SDKs/embeds to buy time? :thinking:

Marco D.: From HW side — one partner reported old bootloader rejects the new header format. Proposed mitigation: server-side adapter shim + vendor patch guide. We can push a vendor PR template.

Olivia R.: Partner comms checklist (draft): partner notification email, partner portal post, staging webhook test, migration samples, scheduled office hours. I'll put a draft in the portal later today.

PartnerBot: Created ticket INF-4721 and added partners: "Nimbus Systems", "CloudLane", "SI-Atlas".

Jessie P.: Quick ask — can we avoid breaking the legacy auth header entirely? If not, can we commit to supporting it for 6 months?

Samir K.: Prefer 3-month hard deprecation + 3-month soft telemetry window. Suggest feature-flagged "compat_bridge" that auto-translates old headers on the gateway. Rollout plan: internal canary -> partner canary -> public deprecate.

Alice N.: Agree to canary + partner window. Canary duration: 2 weeks with selected partners, then 1-month partner-only grace. We also need telemetry keys to watch for 4xx spikes and error-rate regressions.

Marco D.: Technical snippet for migration doc to include (put in examples):
```
# translate old header to new
if 'x-rwd-auth' in req.headers:
    req.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer ' + parse_old(req.headers['x-rwd-auth'])
```
Note: include signer key rotation steps and caveats for embedded devices.

Olivia R.: I'll own partner comms and the announcement copy. Can someone add sample PRs to the top 3 vendor SDKs (Python, Node, Rust)? Marking this as urgent for marketplace listing sync.

PartnerBot: Reminder set for 2026-04-20 to trigger partner-canary invites.

Samir K.: I'll own telemetry dashboards and rollback triggers. Also adding runtime graceful fallback: route to v1-compatible model variant on header mismatch for up to 5s before failing.

Alice N.: Thanks — owners: comms=Olivia, telemetry=Samir, shim+vendor PR=Marco & Jessie. If no objections, I'll send partner advance email tomorrow morning.
